task_description: Classify a statement into one of six truthfulness labels using the statement and provided contextual metadata.

prompts.prompt: Classify the truthfulness of the statement using the provided information. Choose exactly one label: pants-fire, false, barely-true, half-true, mostly-true, or true. Output only the label.

Judge the truthfulness of the statement by considering the statement together with the provided subject, speaker, speaker job, state, party, and context. Choose exactly one label: pants-fire, false, barely-true, half-true, mostly-true, or true. Output only the label.

Evaluate how well the statement is supported by the available contextual information. Use the statement and metadata together rather than relying on wording alone. Return exactly one label: pants-fire, false, barely-true, half-true, mostly-true, or true.

Classify the statement on a six-level truthfulness scale. Distinguish completely false claims from partially true claims and mostly or fully true claims. Use the supplied context and metadata when relevant. Output exactly one of: pants-fire, false, barely-true, half-true, mostly-true, true.

Determine the most appropriate truthfulness label for the statement. Consider the statement itself first, then use the subject, speaker information, political affiliation, location, and context as supporting information when useful. Output only one label: pants-fire, false, barely-true, half-true, mostly-true, or true.
